data.narrative:
Whisper Aero is a Series A-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Mark Moore and Ian Villa that has raised $40M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and Planet Labs, with three directly applicable private comparables at Series B and Seed stages.

Two triangulation methods support valuation. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $40M raised proxy, yielding $80M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies (Cowboy Space Corporation at $2.0B Series B, Aalyria at $1.3B Series B, and Starcloud at $1.1B Seed) produces a median of $1.3B with a range of $1.1B–$2.0B. Public-comp anchoring using the 27.4x P/S median across the five public Space & Aerospace tickers is not applicable due to lack of disclosed revenue for the private target.

The two applicable methods triangulate to a range of $68M (low) to $1.5B (high) with a median of $690M. The wide dispersion reflects the tension between early-stage capital-based floors and later-stage peer valuations. Key uncertainties include whether Whisper Aero's operational metrics and growth trajectory align more closely with earlier-stage or more mature comparables, and the absence of revenue or unit economics to anchor multiples-based approaches.
